name: test-genie.iterate
purpose: Validate a code change efficiently: submit explicit required test phases or the owner's history-informed quick profile, reuse compatible evidence, and return one durable wait command. No full-suite default and no certification claim.

expected_identity.description: Retained source preconditions: optional aggregate identity and/or complete named-root file manifests. Test Genie checks them before admission; an empty object requests ordinary owner resolution.

assumptions: Caller identifies relevant required phases and shared dependency inputs
Test Genie resolves content identity and owns admission and historical cost planning
invariants: Forward retained source preconditions unchanged; do not replace them with a fresh live identity
Omit the expected manifest from output and identify that omission; owner receipts retain resolved source detail
One create call; no wait or retry loop
Certification uses its separately declared policy

signals.intent: Scoped request preview; consult intent_omitted_fields before treating it as a complete request
signals.intent_omitted_fields: Expected identity is omitted when supplied; the original input is forwarded unchanged
signals.expected_manifest: Counts only; never echo raw retained file inventories into the resume packet
signals.selection: Required phases or owner budget strategy
